'''2020 Texas Mini Worlds''' was a Players Committee match-play major on GEMP. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] defeated [[Greg Shaw]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ starwarsccg.org], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210120060217/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' August 2020
* '''Deck changes:''' Players could change decks between stages. The coverage lists separate decks for the Pods and for each single-elimination round (Round of 16, Round of 8, Final 4 and Final Confrontation). In the Pods, many players have two decks listed for the same side.<ref name="pcdecks">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ 2020 Texas Mini Worlds], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013160326/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2020-texas-mini-worlds.html Internet Archive]</ref>
